mapper.sql: id, kitchen_id, org_unit_id, dish_id, dish_snapshot, submitter_id, chef_id, servings, note, priority, claim_mode, scheduled_start_time, status, current_step, started_time, paused_time, completed_time, total_paused_seconds, actual_duration_seconds, submit_token, create_time, last_modify_time
mapper.update: UPDATE cooking_task SET chef_id = #{chefId}, status = 'CLAIMED', last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND chef_id IS NULL
UPDATE cooking_task SET chef_id = NULL, status = 'PENDING', last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND chef_id = #{chefId} AND status IN ('CLAIMED', 'PREPARING')

UPDATE cooking_task SET status = 'COOKING', started_time = COALESCE(started_time, NOW()), paused_time = NULL, last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND chef_id = #{chefId} AND status IN ('CLAIMED', 'PREPARING')
UPDATE cooking_task SET status = 'PAUSED', paused_time = NOW(), last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND chef_id = #{chefId} AND status = 'COOKING'

UPDATE cooking_task SET status = 'COOKING', total_paused_seconds = total_paused_seconds + CASE WHEN paused_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paused_time))::int) END, paused_time = NULL, last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND chef_id = #{chefId} AND status = 'PAUSED'

UPDATE cooking_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_time = NOW(), actual_duration_seconds = CASE WHEN started_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - started_time))::int - total_paused_seconds - CASE WHEN paused_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paused_time))::int END) END, paused_time = NULL, last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND chef_id = #{chefId} AND status IN ('COOKING', 'PAUSED')
UPDATE cooking_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'PREPARING') AND (submitter_id = #{userId} OR chef_id = #{userId})
UPDATE cooking_task SET current_step = #{currentStep}, last_modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cooking_task WHERE submit_token = #{submitToken} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM cooking_task WHERE org_unit_id = #{orgUnitId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'PREPARING', 'COOKING', 'PAUSED') AND (chef_id IS NULL OR chef_id = #{userId} OR submitter_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM cooking_task WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
